# Measured weights for the internal/testing/e2e catch-all shards
# (test-e2e-other.yml), in seconds.
#
# `TestName seconds` per line; `#` comments and blanks ignored. A name with no
# entry weighs 1, so this file steers BALANCE only: scripts/shard-tests
# partitions the live list and cmd/ci-test-workers splits a shard between its
# workers, and every listed name lands in exactly one bucket whatever its
# weight. A stale weight costs an unevenly filled shard, nothing more.
#
# The lane's tests are mostly sub-second. The TestRunner*ExamplePasses suites
# whose tests/stdlib file the self-host stdtest lane also runs
# (selfHostStdTestCases) were deleted on 2026-10-25, which removed the TLS,
# QUIC, compression and public-key interpreter runs that took minutes each.
#
# Measured 2026-10-25 on the 4-core dev container with other work beside it:
# the lane's selection through cmd/ci-test-workers with two workers, 1655
# tests in 41.7 minutes. Every test at 10 s or more is listed. The CI runner
# reads lower, and the ratio between rows is what the partition uses.
